metadata.method_notes: Executors were clean-context general-purpose subagents. with_skill runs were pointed at the installed skill directory and instructed to follow it; without_skill runs were instructed to answer from their own judgment and not consult installed skills. All runs read-only. Two assertions were amended mid-run BEFORE any grading, disclosed here: eval 1 assertion 1 and eval 2 assertion 3 originally encoded the author's predicted answer rather than the skill's doctrine (a verified-online edit is compliant, and the lowest-dimension rule can outrank deletion-preference); both were reworded to test the doctrine and all runs were graded against the amended text only. Analyzer = the session model grading final responses against assertions with quoted evidence.

summary.cost_note: with_skill runs averaged ~82k subagent tokens and 127s vs ~49k and 36s without — the skill costs roughly +65% tokens per task in exchange for the behavioral deltas below.
